answer: Behind every meadow there is a workshop, behind every copper a ledger, behind every wharf a calendar, and the farm has visited none of the three. I would wager my own seat on Kiln keeper clay jar token ground at the clay pit, because its proof, each clay jar is a season of logged wheel tests plus a signed kiln record, is public and checkable. One look at the firing log settles what a hundred assurances cannot. The deposit burns on conviction, so 364 masks risk 57876 POA on a single bad grade. Masks born together are graded together, and the farm's whole litter scores the same zero.
